title: Sales orders
emptyNone: No sales orders yet. Use “New Order” to create one, choose Cash or Credit, then submit it.

actions.cancelConfirmedPrompt: Reason for cancelling {{orderNo}}? The stock will be returned and its cash/credit sale will be voided.
actions.approveConfirm: Approve {{orderNo}}? Stock will be issued for every line.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete {{orderNo}} permanently? This cannot be undone.
actions.approveConfirmCash: Approve {{orderNo}}? Stock will be issued and a Cash sale will be created automatically.
actions.approveConfirmCredit: Approve {{orderNo}}? Stock will be issued and a Credit sale (receivable) will be created automatically.
actions.approvedWithSale: {{orderNo}} approved. {{type}} {{saleNo}} was created and is now on the Sales page and the {{type}}s page.

create.title: New sales order
create.subtitle: Choose Cash or Credit. Nothing moves until the order is submitted and approved; then the sale is created automatically.
create.saved: Draft saved. Submit it for approval when you are ready.
create.savedSubmitted: Order saved and submitted for approval.
create.savedSubmitFailed: Draft saved, but it could not be submitted: {{error}}

edit.title: Edit sales order
edit.subtitle: {{orderNo}} · only drafts can be edited
edit.locked: This order is {{status}} or belongs to someone else, so it can no longer be edited here.
edit.updatedSubmitted: Order updated and submitted for approval.
edit.updatedSubmitFailed: Draft updated, but it could not be submitted: {{error}}

view.saleNotYet: Created automatically when the order is approved
view.willCreateCash: When this order is approved it becomes a Cash sale automatically (Sales page + Cash sales page).
view.willCreateCredit: When this order is approved it becomes a Credit sale automatically (Sales page + Credit sales page).

form.customerPlaceholder: Search customer by name, code or phone
form.createdForYou: This order is created for you.
form.itemPlaceholder: Search item by name, SKU or barcode
form.priceFromCatalogue: Prices come from the item catalogue
form.noDiscountAllowed: You are not allowed to give discounts
form.estimateNote: Estimate only. The final amounts are calculated when you save.
form.cashHelp: Customer pays in full now. Appears on the Cash sales page after approval.
form.creditHelp: Customer pays later. Appears on the Credit sales page after approval.
form.dueAuto_one: Leave empty to use the customer’s payment terms ({{count}} day from the order date).
form.dueAuto_other: Leave empty to use the customer’s payment terms ({{count}} days from the order date).
form.dueAutoNoCustomer: Leave empty to use the customer’s payment terms.
form.flowCASH: After approval: stock is issued and a paid Cash sale is created. It then appears on the Sales and Cash sales pages.
form.flowCREDIT: After approval: stock is issued and an unpaid Credit sale is created (credit limit is checked). It then appears on the Sales and Credit sales pages.

problems.lineNeedsItem: Every line needs an item. Remove empty lines.
problems.qtyPositive: Every quantity must be greater than 0.
problems.itemTwice: An item appears twice. Combine it into one line.
problems.deliveryBeforeOrder: Delivery date cannot be before the order date.
problems.chooseSaleType: Choose Cash sale or Credit sale.
problems.dueBeforeOrder: Due date cannot be before the order date.
problems.totalPositive: The order total must be greater than zero.
